title: 第 10 章 陆云竟然败了
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陆云站在原地脸色铁青，这会儿盯着陈默的背影此刻他心中的怒火一下子就爆发了。

    要知道他在外门这么多年还从来没有人敢这么对他，可是陈默这个废物竟然敢无视他。

    如果今天要是不给陈默一点教训的话，以后他陆云在外门还有什么威信可言？

    想到这里他立刻大怒，紧接着体内的真元疯狂涌动整个人立刻朝陈默的背后袭去。

    “陈默你站住！”

    只听他大喝一声便将一掌拍出，可以说这一掌他用尽了全力而且掌风中还带着凌厉的杀意。

    必须让陈默知道得罪他陆云的下场。

    可就在这时陆瑶和刚刚两个师妹也赶到了现场，当她们刚转过弯就看到陆云对陈默出手的一幕。

    “陆云师兄出手了！”一个师妹兴奋的喊道。

    “师兄快狠狠教训那个不知天高地厚的家伙！让他知道知道得罪陆瑶师姐的下场！”

    那两个师妹在旁边拍手叫好而且脸上全是一副看好戏的表情。

    至于站在一旁的陆瑶也忍不住笑了起来，心想陈默你死定了，自己哥哥可是金丹大圆满的实力打你一个废物还不是轻轻松松？

    等陆云把他打趴下以后自己一定要好好羞辱他一顿，到时候让陈默跪下来给自己磕头。

    可下一秒的时候就注意到她脸上的笑容瞬间僵住了，只见陈默头都没回就感觉到背后的掌风随后身体一闪。

    那陆云的一掌擦着他的衣服拍了过去，竟然打了个空。

    紧接着陈默抬起右手随手一挡。

    砰的一声响起，只听两掌相撞陆云当场就感觉到一股巨大的力量从陈默的掌中传来。

    于是脸色一变，身体还不受控制的往后退了好几步才勉强站稳。

    可是陈默站在原地纹丝未动竟然连头都没有回，看到这里后所有人都愣住了。

    特别是刚刚两个师妹，此刻都张着嘴说不出话来眼睛瞪得大大的。

    怎么可能。

    要知道陆云师兄可是金丹大圆满的实力，竟然被陈默随手一挡就逼退了？

    一定是陆云师兄没有用全力。

    看到这里的陆瑶也愣住了，只见她脸上的笑容彻底消失了。

    并盯着陈默的背影在心里翻来覆去的想着。

    这不可能。

    绝对不可能，就凭陈默这个废物怎么可能挡得住她哥陆云的攻击。

    毕竟陆云可是金丹大圆满的修为，而且在整个外门没几个人是他对手，那个陈默算什么东西一个废物凭什么能挡住？

    咬着嘴唇的她根本不愿意相信眼前看到的这一幕。

    特别是陆云，这个时候他的脸色更是难看极了，只见他站稳之后便抬起头盯着陈默，尤其是那眼神里简直是充满了震惊和愤怒。
content_en:
Lu Yun stood there with a pale face, staring at Chen Mo's back. The anger in his heart suddenly burst out.

    You must know that in all his years in the outer sect, no one has ever dared to treat him like this, but Chen Mo, a loser, dared to ignore him.

    If Chen Mo is not taught a lesson today, what prestige will Lu Yun have in the outer sect in the future?

    Thinking of this, he immediately became furious, and then the real energy in his body surged crazily and he immediately attacked Chen Mo's back.

    "Chen Mo, stop!"

    He just heard him shout loudly and then slapped out a palm. It can be said that he used all his strength with this palm and the wind of the palm was filled with fierce killing intent.

    Chen Mo must know what will happen to Lu Yun if he offends him.

    But at this moment, Lu Yao and the other two junior sisters also arrived at the scene. As soon as they turned the corner, they saw Lu Yun taking action against Chen Mo.

    "Senior Brother Lu Yun has taken action!" a junior sister shouted excitedly.

    "Senior brother, hurry up and teach that ignorant guy a lesson! Let him know the consequences of offending Senior Sister Lu Yao!"

    The two junior sisters clapped and applauded nearby, with expressions on their faces as if they were watching a good show.

    As for Lu Yao who was standing aside, she couldn't help but laugh. She thought to herself, Chen Mo, you are dead. His brother has the perfect strength of the Golden Core. Isn't it easy to beat you to a waste?

    After Lu Yun knocked him down, he must humiliate him, and then let Chen Mo kneel down and kowtow to him.

    But the next second, he noticed that the smile on her face froze. Chen Mo didn't even turn around when he felt the wind from the palm behind him and then his body flashed.

    Lu Yun's palm grazed his clothes and hit him in vain.

    Then Chen Mo raised his right hand and blocked it casually.

    There was a bang, and Lu Yun felt a huge force coming from Chen Mo's palm as soon as he heard the collision of two palms.

    Then his face changed, and he took several steps back uncontrollably before he managed to stand still.

    But Chen Mo stood still and didn't even turn his head. Everyone was stunned when they saw this.

    Especially the two junior sisters just now were speechless with their mouths open and their eyes wide open.

    How is it possible.

    You must know that Senior Brother Lu Yun has the perfect strength of Jin Dan, but he was forced to retreat by Chen Mo with just a block?

    It must be that Senior Brother Lu Yun didn't use all his strength.

    Lu Yao was also stunned when she saw this, and the smile on her face completely disappeared.

    He stared at Chen Mo's back and thought over and over in his mind.

    This is impossible.

    Absolutely impossible, how could a loser like Chen Mo be able to block her brother Lu Yun's attack.

    After all, Lu Yun has the cultivation level of Jindan Dzogchen, and there are few people in the entire outer sect who can match him. Who is Chen Mo, a loser? How can he stop him?

    Biting her lip, she simply didn't want to believe the scene she saw in front of her.

    Especially Lu Yun, his face was even more ugly at this time. After he stood firm, he raised his head and stared at Chen Mo, especially his eyes were full of shock and anger.
